class Chan:
    cap: int
    buf: list[int]

def new_chan(cap: int) -> Chan:
    """Empty channel that holds at most cap items."""
    pre cap >= 0
    ex new_chan(2) == Chan(cap=2, buf=[])
    return Chan(cap=cap, buf=[])

def is_full(ch: Chan) -> bool:
    """True when ch holds cap items and a send would not be accepted."""
    ex is_full(Chan(cap=1, buf=[7])) == True
    ex is_full(Chan(cap=2, buf=[7])) == False
    return ch.buf.len() >= ch.cap

def push(ch: Chan, v: int) -> Chan:
    """Channel after v is appended, given that ch has room."""
    pre not is_full(ch)
    post out.buf.len() == ch.buf.len() + 1
    ex push(Chan(cap=1, buf=[]), 7) == Chan(cap=1, buf=[7])
    nb = ch.buf.copy()
    nb.append(v)
    return Chan(cap=ch.cap, buf=nb)

def accepted(cap: int, xs: list[int]) -> int uses nondet:
    """Number of elements of xs accepted by a non-blocking channel of capacity cap before it fills; sending stops at the first refusal."""
    pre cap >= 0
    post 0 <= out and out <= cap and out <= xs.len()
    ch = new_chan(cap=cap)
    n = 0
    for v in xs:
        if is_full(ch):
            break
        ch = push(ch, v)
        n += 1
    return n
